name: brand-accent-foreground
usage: Text/icon on --brand-accent fills (CTAs, selected tiers). AAA on-mineral contrast: white on the light-theme deep tanzanite, deep-violet (#2E004D) on the dark-theme lavender. Apps overriding --brand-accent to a light mineral (malachite/gold/kalahari) also set this to a near-black. Components chain to --primary-foreground when unset.
